quizName: Hardest Questions in Delaware Most difficult questions from your region.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black symbols or letters. This sign warns you that a railroad crossing is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Vehicles will be entering the roadway.
Come to a complete stop and proceed when it is safe to do so.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a complete stop and proceed when it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: Red octagonal signs are always stop signs. You must come to a complete stop, check for traffic and pedestrians, then proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: Improper braking:

options.text: Is a significant contributing factor to many motorcycle crashes.
Should not be a concern, since the motorcycle has two brakes.

questions.correctAnswerText: Is a significant contributing factor to many motorcycle crashes.
questions.explanation: Improper braking causes many motorcycle crashes. Using the right braking technique is essential for safe riding.

questions.question: The best clothing for a motorcyclist:

options.text: Should not stand out to other motorists.

questions.explanation: Good riding clothing protects you in a crash, keeps you comfortable, and makes you visible to other drivers.

questions.question: Blind spots on motorcycles:

options.text: Should be consistently checked by riders.
Don't exist if the motorcycle has a rearview mirror.

questions.correctAnswerText: Should be consistently checked by riders.
questions.explanation: Motorcycles have blind spots like any other vehicle. Always turn your head to check your blind spot before changing lanes.

questions.question: Taking over-the-counter medication before riding:

options.text: Is usually fine since over-the-counter medications are never very strong.
May affect your riding abilities and should be done with caution.

questions.correctAnswerText: May affect your riding abilities and should be done with caution.
questions.explanation: Many medications, including over-the-counter drugs, have side effects that can affect your riding ability. Ask your doctor how any new medication might affect your ability to ride safely.

questions.question: When riding, you should wear:
questions.explanation: Wear bright colors to help other drivers see you. Reflective clothing is also helpful.

questions.question: To make it easier to be seen by other motorists, you should:
questions.explanation: Bright clothing helps other drivers see you, day or night.

questions.question: When traveling at night, it is:

options.text: Easier to judge distances than it is during the day.
About as easy to judge distances as it is during the day.
More difficult to judge distances than it is during the day.

questions.correctAnswerText: More difficult to judge distances than it is during the day.
questions.explanation: It is harder to judge distances at night than during the day. Shadows and light help us judge distance. At night, artificial light distorts or removes these helpful cues.

questions.question: The faster you drink alcohol:

options.text: The faster the alcohol is removed from your body.
The faster the alcohol accumulates in your body.
The less the alcohol affects your body.

questions.correctAnswerText: The faster the alcohol accumulates in your body.
questions.explanation: Your body removes about one drink per hour. If you drink faster than this, alcohol builds up in your system.

questions.question: Choose a lane position that makes you more visible and gives you space around your motorcycle.

options.text: Makes you more visible and gives you a safe space cushion.
You prefer, without thinking about other riders.
Puts you close to other vehicles.

questions.correctAnswerText: Makes you more visible and gives you a safe space cushion.
questions.explanation: Position yourself where other drivers can see you best. Keep space between you and other vehicles. The best lane position changes with road and traffic conditions.

questions.question: What is most important when buying a motorcycle helmet?

options.text: How well it protects your head

questions.correctAnswerText: How well it protects your head
questions.explanation: Protection is the most important factor when buying a helmet. Choose one that fastens securely, fits correctly, and meets DOT standards.

questions.question: When buying a motorcycle helmet, focus most on the helmet's:
questions.explanation: Protection should be your top priority when choosing a helmet.

questions.question: Which material offers the best protection for motorcycle riders?
questions.explanation: Leather and sturdy synthetic materials provide the best protection for motorcycle riders.

questions.question: What should you do when riding on a slippery surface?
questions.explanation: On slippery surfaces, reduce speed, avoid sudden movements, and use both brakes carefully.

questions.question: Reflective and brightly-colored helmets and clothing:

options.text: Should only be worn when riding at night
Help other drivers see you better

questions.correctAnswerText: Help other drivers see you better
questions.explanation: Wearing bright or reflective clothing increases the chances that other drivers will see you.

questions.question: Before every ride, you should check:

options.text: That the paint is not peeling
That the bike is completely clean

questions.explanation: Check your brakes before every ride. Test each brake to make sure the brake lights turn on.

questions.question: How do you become sober after drinking alcohol?
questions.explanation: Time is the only way your body removes alcohol. Nothing else will speed up this process.

questions.question: When riding a motorcycle, you should:

options.text: Only wear a jacket at night
Only wear a jacket when it is cold

questions.explanation: Always wear a sturdy jacket with long sleeves when riding, even on warm days.

questions.question: To get the most protection from your helmet, make sure it:
questions.explanation: For maximum protection, choose a helmet that meets DOT standards, fits snugly all around, and has no damage.

questions.question: When stopping your motorcycle with a passenger, what should you do?

options.text: Start slowing down earlier than normal.
Merge into smaller traffic gaps than normal.

questions.correctAnswerText: Start slowing down earlier than normal.
questions.explanation: A passenger adds weight to your motorcycle. Extra weight makes your motorcycle respond more slowly. It takes longer to speed up, slow down, and turn. When carrying a passenger, slow down earlier, start braking sooner, and look for bigger gaps in traffic.

questions.question: When approaching a blind intersection, what should you do?

options.text: Assume other drivers will yield the right-of-way.
Move to a lane position that makes you more visible.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to a lane position that makes you more visible.
questions.explanation: At a blind intersection, position your motorcycle so other drivers can see you better.

questions.question: Wearing what gives you the best chance of surviving a crash?
questions.explanation: A helmet that meets DOT standards gives you the best protection for your head and neck. Wearing a proper helmet that is securely fastened is the most important thing you can do to survive a crash.

questions.question: Why should you use your mirrors when stopping at an intersection?

options.text: To check if drivers behind you see that you are stopping.
To look for dark clouds indicating bad weather.

questions.correctAnswerText: To check if drivers behind you see that you are stopping.
questions.explanation: Always check your mirrors to see if vehicles behind you are paying attention to your movements. Use your mirrors at intersections to make sure drivers behind you are reacting properly to your stop.

questions.question: What should you do to prevent fatigue while riding?
questions.explanation: Take breaks often on long rides to reduce fatigue. Caffeine can make fatigue worse when it wears off. Wind, rain, and snow increase fatigue. Dress warmly and use a windshield on long rides.
